system.description:
WING BURST

FLOURISH MOVEMENT

Action 1 AP

You can Fly up to your Speed. You must end this movement on a surface capable of supporting you; otherwise, you fall normally.

Use: checks Flourish's once-a-turn limit, spends 1 AP and arms your next token move — up to your land Speed, by any movement. Ending it in the air is a fall, made through the Falling action as usual.
